messages.content: Analysis of the waveform: the reference `q` becomes `1` right after the posedge at 15ns (`a=0` at that posedge) and `0` after the posedge at 45ns (`a=1`), i.e. `q` is the **inversion of `a` delayed by one clock cycle**: `q(N) = ~a(N-1)`. The current DUT registers `a` then inverts it, creating a two-cycle delay, so `q` stays `x` a cycle too long (first mismatch at 20ns). Fix: a single register sampling `~a`.
